claire-docs: Quick q: region page still shows the `?region=` pattern in the CLI examples and the region table uses a single endpoint hostname. Ops prefers showing explicit regional hostnames (eu.api.redwood.ai) + header example. Which should be canonical? cc @pete-eng

pete-eng: We're standardizing on two canonical patterns: 1) header-first (`X-Redwood-Region`) with the global endpoint, 2) regional hostname for customers who pin DNS/A rules. Docs should show header-first in SDK/CLI snippets, and add a separate box describing DNS aliases.

leo-sdk: I'll put together a Go snippet (we don't have many Go examples yet). Draft:

```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("RW_KEY"))
client.SetHeader("X-Redwood-Region", "eu-west-1")
resp, _ := client.Generate(context.Background(), redwood.GenerateParams{Model: "redwood-mini", Input: "Hi"})
fmt.Println(resp.Text)
```

claire-docs: Nice. Also want a tiny migration section for CLI tooling authors: how to change `--region=eu` to header or hostname.

pete-eng: Example migration for curl and az cli wrappers: `curl -H 'X-Redwood-Region: ap-southeast-1' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` or use `https://ap-southeast-1.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` if you've configured routing.

anya-legal: For the residency blurb, please use this approved one-liner (public docs): "When a region is selected, inference compute and ephemeral caches process data in that region; persistent records such as billing and audit logs are retained according to your residency agreement." Use that under every header/hostname snippet.

claire-docs: Perfect — I'll add that as the caption. i18n question: should we show localized examples for number/date formatting in the SDK examples? @i18n-bot

i18n-bot: yes — show a small callout: "Examples below use ISO timestamps unless noted; localized formatting guidance in the Localization section." Also remind translators to surface the residency caption.

leo-sdk: One more: older SDK versions (<=1.2.3) won't set headers via the new SetHeader API. We should list minimum versions that support header-first and show compatibility fallback (`?region=`).

pete-eng: Add compatibility note and script snippet for maintainers to bulk-update examples in repos. Something simple like: `rg "\?region=([a-z0-9-]+)" -l | xargs sed -i "s/\?region=\([a-z0-9-]\+\)/-H 'X-Redwood-Region: \1'/g"` but include a preview `rg` run before sed.

claire-docs: I'll prepare the PR: 1) header-first SDK snippets (Node/Go/Python), 2) regional hostnames callout, 3) migration snippet + repo-swap tip, 4) residency caption and link to /residency/faq, 5) i18n TODO.

preview-bot: docs-preview: branch `docs/regions-hostname-header` deployed to https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/regions (build 1345) :rocket:

anya-legal: Approved. Small ask: add an FAQ Q/A: "Will audit logs be kept locally?" Answer: "Audit logs and billing are handled per contract; contact your CSM for specific retention."

claire-docs: Will include that FAQ and ping translations. Targeting a tiny patch PR today. Thanks everyone! :sparkles:
